cases.prompt: Write an LLM tool definition (function calling schema) for our endpoint GET /orders/{id}, which returns the order status.
expectations: Defines one tool with a clear name and a description that says when the model should use it.
The parameter schema is a JSON Schema object with an order id property, typed and listed as required.
Describes or shows what the tool returns or how the API response maps to the tool result.

cases.prompt: Expose our createInvoice, getInvoice and deleteInvoice endpoints as MCP tools. Any design advice?
expectations: Gives each of the three operations its own tool with a descriptive name and input schema.
Treats deleteInvoice as destructive: asks for confirmation, a guard, or clear labelling of the side effect.
Advises returning clear, model-readable errors rather than raw stack traces or bare status codes.
